name: Elwood Orchard
description: Elwood Orchard is a pumpkin patch in 44 Snake Hill Road, RI. Visitors come for Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples, best in summer. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Apr – Jun in this growing zone.
Contact the farm directly to confirm current hours and what is ready to pick.
